I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL backend to use `database` and `password` kwargs instead of the deprecated `db` and `passwd` kwargs.

### Summary of Changes
1. **[`django/db/backends/mysql/base.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-u0n8jd2i/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L202-L205)**:
   Updated `get_connection_params()` to map `settings_dict['NAME']` to `'database'` and `settings_dict['PASSWORD']` to `'password'`.
2. **[`django/db/backends/mysql/client.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-u0n8jd2i/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L11-L14)**:
   Updated `DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()` to check for `database` in `OPTIONS` in addition to fallback `db`.
3. **Tests**:
   Added tests in [`tests/backends/mysql/tests.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-u0n8jd2i/tests/backends/mysql/tests.py#L93-L101) and [`tests/dbshell/test_mysql.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-u0n8jd2i/tests/dbshell/test_mysql.py#L92-L111) to verify connection parameters and database option parsing.
